ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

calibration_categories.name: Pixel-rate sweep + PLL lock check
calibration_categories.purpose: Sweep f_IDCK = 25 to 165 MHz; confirm PLL locks at every rate; measure lock time.

calibration_categories.name: TFADJ resistor trim (V_SWING)
calibration_categories.purpose: Sweep R_TFADJ 300-800 Ω; pick value (≈ 510 Ω) that lands V_SWING in 400-600 mV target band (see Figure 5-6 RTFADJ vs Vswing curve).

calibration_categories.name: Eye diagram on TMDS pairs
calibration_categories.purpose: At target f_IDCK, capture per-pair eye height (≥ 400 mV diff target), eye width (≥ 0.5 UI), jitter ≤ 150 ps; verify common-mode noise immunity.

calibration_categories.name: TMDS rise/fall measurement
calibration_categories.purpose: 20-80% rise and fall times within 75-240 ps at 165 MHz.

calibration_categories.name: Intra-pair skew t_sk(D) measurement
calibration_categories.purpose: ≤ 50 ps; measured at 50% crossover of TX+/TX-.

calibration_categories.name: Channel-to-channel skew t_sk(CC) measurement
calibration_categories.purpose: ≤ 1.2 ns at 165 MHz; measured differentially using IDCK+ as reference.

calibration_categories.name: Output clock jitter t_ojit
calibration_categories.purpose: ≤ 150 ps relative to IDCK; characterize PLL noise.

calibration_categories.name: Input setup/hold margin (t_su / t_h)
calibration_categories.purpose: Sweep DATA arrival time relative to IDCK edge; find sweet spot inside spec window.

calibration_categories.name: De-skew trim sweep (DK[3:1])
calibration_categories.purpose: Iterate 8 codes; pick best DK to compensate per-board DATA-vs-IDCK skew.

calibration_categories.name: I2C register integrity
calibration_categories.purpose: Round-trip write/read of CTL_1_MODE / CTL_2_MODE / CTL_3_MODE / DE_* registers; verify reset behavior.

calibration_categories.name: DDC EDID read
calibration_categories.purpose: Read EDID 128-byte block from receiver via I2C/DDC at 0xA0; verify checksum byte = 0.

calibration_categories.name: HPD edge detection
calibration_categories.purpose: Pulse EDGE/HTPLG pin LOW-HIGH; confirm HTPLG bit transitions; MDI interrupt fires.

calibration_categories.name: RSEN sense (DC-coupled only)
calibration_categories.purpose: Connect powered receiver; verify RSEN bit set; disconnect, verify cleared.

calibration_categories.name: Power-down current I_PD
calibration_categories.purpose: Measure I_DD with PD=0; expect ≤ 500 µA typical.

calibration_categories.name: Normal current I_DD
calibration_categories.purpose: Measure at worst-case checkerboard pattern; expect ≤ 250 mA at 165 MHz.

calibration_categories.name: ESD test
calibration_categories.purpose: DVI pins ±4 kV HBM; other pins ±2 kV HBM per ANSI/ESDA/JEDEC JS-001.

calibration_categories.name: Temperature corner sweep
calibration_categories.purpose: 0 °C, 25 °C, 70 °C; verify all timing parameters in spec.

notes: TFP410 has multiple analog risk areas — TFADJ-controlled current driver, 10× PLL, differential clock crossover detector, low-swing input comparator. Lab characterization on every new board is recommended. Compliance test suites: DVI Compliance Test Specification (DDWG) and HDMI Compliance Test Specification (HDMI LLC) provide the formal test programmes; this list captures the spec-derived characterization categories.
